answer: The strongest sybil defense is kinship-excluded attestation weight: an agent's score grows only from vouches by peers outside its formation cluster, so agents named dune, jade, and raven, all minted by one operator in one batch, detect that shared provenance and earn each other zero. Reputation flows only through genuinely independent history, so fabricating it means cultivating thousands of unrelated peers over real time with real work, while every fresh fake node starts worthless and adds nothing to its own ring.
